gameplay.babel.n_6: Attention: §eYou've switched to a high difficulty for Caerula Arbor, please take care.
gameplay.babel.n_12: Warn: §cYou've switched to a very high difficulty for Caerula Arbor, it isn't for normal survival games.
gameplay.relic_ban.notice.0: Advanced relics are banned in this world.
gameplay.relic_ban.notice.1: This notice will only be shown once.
gameplay.life_point.revive.0: Your've well dined and revives {num} Life Point!
gameplay.life_point.revive.1: You've tasted delicacies and revives {num} Life Point!

item.babel.omnikey.description_0: §bPlayer get 3 levels of exp when used
item.babel.omnikey.description_1: §oA key used to open any door
item.babel.gold_expedition.description_0: §bGain 32 exp and 8 gold ingots when used
item.babel.gold_expedition.description_1: §oFrom wasteland first the queen did start,
item.babel.gold_expedition.description_2: §o Beneath her gown markets sprung like spring's own heart.
item.babel.gold_expedition.description_3: §oWealth's roads through mountains tall, forests profound,
item.babel.gold_expedition.description_4: §oTill she vanished where western waves kiss the bound.
item.babel.piglin_diary.description_1: §oFrom which we can learn the ideas of piglins about overworld
item.babel.kettle.description_0: §bPlayer Maxhealth +1 and gain 8 exp when used
item.babel.kettle.description_1: §oYou shouldn't boil your instant noodle straightly in your mouth!
item.babel.bat_bed.description_1: §oA bed daid to be for vampires, but where can we find them?
item.babel.rainbow_candy.description_0: §bGain Strength II, Resistance II and Healthboost II when eaten
item.babel.rainbow_candy.description_1: §oCandy product by Peter, known by abundant taste
death.attack.true_damage: %1$s was killed by %2$s with true damage
death.attack.true_damage.player: %1$s was killed by %2$s with true damage
item.babel.hand_fertility.description_0: §bPlayer deals extra magic damage of 3% of the target's current health when attacking with a hoe or hitting with a tipped arrow
item.babel.hand_thorns.description_1: §oLet him to do it by himself, and blow himself off
item.babel.hand_strangle.description_0: §bInstakill mobs whose health under 20% if hit by crossbow
item.babel.hand_strangle.description_1: §oto vanish his last breath with my last power
item.babel.hand_speed.description_0: §bPlayer gain haste III and attack speed +1.8 when no one around and he's using a pickaxe
item.babel.hand_speed.description_1: §oSwing you arms and only shadows left
item.babel.hand_firework.description_0: §bPlayer shoot with bow got 25% chance to deal 200% AoE damage to the target
item.babel.hand_swipe.description_0: §bPlayer with Regeneration buff deals damage to surrounding mobs
item.babel.hand_of_barren.description_0: §bIf player crits with axe, his attack =20% for max 8 times, and get emptied if not attacking for 8s
item.babel.hand_of_barren.description_1: §oMilleniums of growth, vanished in a second
item.babel.chitinous_ripper.description_: §bOn attack, 5% chance to gain +100% attack damage and +100% max health for 20 seconds
§oA more efficient exoskeleton growth scheme. It tears prey apart, withstands blows, and can even become food for kin.
item.babel.fearless_blade.description_0: §bOn attack, 5% chance to gain +50% attack damage and +50% armor for 15 seconds
item.babel.fearless_blade.description_1: §oHe stood before the city gate, guarding this entrance of Kazdel alone. The Gaulish artillery, the Leithanian caster corps, and the Victorian knights came in waves, all trying to break through a defense line held by a single Sarkaz. Yet until the gate was blown apart, until the coalition decided to retreat, this Goliath swordsman never took a single step back.
item.babel.devotion.description_0: §bOn attack or heal, deal 5 magic damage to a random enemy within 12 blocks
item.babel.devotion.description_1: §oSince ancient times, this tribe has believed they alone hold the truth of Sami: once, all things had their own voices, until "He" began to speak for them all.
item.babel.white_flower_crown.descriptio: §bHealing and health regeneration the player receives are increased by 30%
§oA flower crown veil used in Bloodkin rituals. The once scarlet life has been drained dry, leaving only pallor.
item.babel.necklace_of_presence.descript: §oFaith hangs ten centimeters above your heart; language flows into your blood, and bullets slide into your magazine.
item.babel.revolver_cylinder.description: §oShe never once bowed to villainy through mountains of blades and seas of fire; the flame at her muzzle blazed like a raging sun, and the light above her head burned brighter than day. Here lies Outcast, our friend.
item.babel.leithanian_medal_of_honor.des: §oThe two Empresses rarely do one thing together; honoring those who create art is one of them.
item.babel.conval_experience_card.descri: §bAttack speed +25% while the player has Regeneration
§oLying on a lounge chair in the courtyard basking in the sun, the whole day's fatigue melts away.
item.babel.rusted_iron_hammer.descriptio: §bOriginium prices -50% when buying collectibles from Cannot Goodenough's shop
§o"Change is necessary, and we should let the storm come a little faster."
item.babel.conval_prime_membership.descr: §bAttack speed +45% while the player has Regeneration
§oPrime-tier convalescence: dedicated care, tailored meals, and unlimited hot tea refills.
item.babel.silver_forks.description_1: §oOne fork to deal with failed actors, one to settle accounts with clumsy playwrights, and one for whoever needs it. The head chef tolerates no mistakes at the dinner table.
item.babel.first_aid_kit.description_1: §o"...Antibiotics and ethanol additives. Use under professional guidance." — Rim Billiton Safety Production Guide
item.babel.the_silence.description_1: §oA painting of the greatest catastrophe in Iberian history. The brushwork means nothing, the colors mean nothing, the imagery means nothing. "Ægir knows, Ægir knows, Ægir knows."
item.babel.vieux_vanguards_blade.descrip: §bThe player deals 35% more melee attack damage
§oGaul shall witness the sacrifice of the old guard, and only then meet its own demise.
item.babel.fowlbeast_liver_pate.descript: §oBottled premium fowlbeast liver pate, vividly colored, reserved for the aristocracy.
item.babel.vanilla_soda.description_0: §bGain Regeneration II for 30s and Speed I for 20s when used
item.babel.vanilla_soda.description_1: §oA cheap local drink from Bolívar with over a century of history, blended with various spices. Notably tastes bad.
item.babel.actor_perfume.description_0: §bThe player regenerates 1% of their max. health every second
item.babel.actor_perfume.description_1: §oStage actors spray some on before going on stage. This stable, fragrant scent continuously soothes the performers' stress — at least, that's how it looks on the surface.
item.babel.dreaming_essence.description_: §oIt is said the perfume crafted by the banshees is only gifted to their beloved. A single drop sends one into rapture, and with it come the inspiration and creativity of artists.
item.babel.carriage_whip.description_0: §bNearby enemy units take 25% more physical damage
item.babel.carriage_whip.description_1: §oAs the troupe's carriage driver, he has no name and no past. Only by cracking his whip to drive the pack beasts onward does his life hold meaning.
item.babel.children_puppet.description_0: §bEnemies take 7.5 magic damage per second while stunned, frozen, or bound
item.babel.children_puppet.description_1: §oThe children of Iberia turned the strange things found along the coast into crude little dolls. They say that holding one makes your dreams all the richer.
item.babel.second_economic_reform_act.de: §bGrants the Hero of the Village effect for 4.5 minutes on use
§oWith this act as its starting point, Gaul formally set out on the road to hegemonic empire.
item.babel.royal_rapier.description_0: §bThe player deals 25% more melee attack damage
item.babel.royal_rapier.description_1: §oAn elaborately decorated noble's rapier. First wielded by the Gallic aristocracy, it is altogether too fragile to serve as a weapon of war.
item.babel.avenger.description_0: §bNearby enemy units take 35% more physical damage
item.babel.avenger.description_1: §oThe first weapon Ascalon ever carried — personally presented by Theresa after she completed her first mission for the Military Commission, with the blade fitted by Theresis.
item.babel.unknown_instrument.descriptio: §oDon't ask. Consider it a favor to yourself.
item.babel.supreme_ring.description_1: §oIn Leithanian myth, the ring-bearer enjoys the wealth of the whole land, yet is doomed to perish by greed.
item.babel.hand_sword.description_0: §bEnemies armor and toughness -70% for 6s when hit, player revive 10% health simultaneously
item.babel.hand_sword.description_1: §oTo flaten the mount and smash the ground
item.babel.hand_of_engrave.description_0: §bEverytime when player kill with a trident, he gets 1% addition of attack and max health, only functions with a trident
item.babel.hand_of_snatcher.description_: §b10% chance to gain an emerald for each enemy killed, movement speed +10% while having Hero of the Village
§oWhatever is missing, take it from the enemy. Don't be shy.
item.babel.hand_of_diffusion.description: §bChanneling damage grants Strength II for 2s per enemy hit, stacking up to 45s, also allows channeling in rain while active
§oOne more enemy beaten, one more bit of strength saved.
item.babel.vampires_bed.description_0: §bWhen target life is full, defense +20%, spell resistance +10
item.babel.vampires_bed.description_1: §oSleeping shall be an eternity for those who enthrone
item.babel.king_crown.description_0: §bPlayer attack + 50%, and +150% if gained three King relics
item.babel.king_crown.description_1: §oOh Your Late Majesty, I pray that you protect our Land
item.babel.relic_crown.description_0: §bPlayer attack +50% when target life is 1 or lower, boosted to +150% with three King relics gathered
item.babel.relic_crown.description_1: §oOh nameless kings, even in ruin may you still watch over Iberia
item.babel.king_staff.description_0: §bRestores 1 hunger point every 16 seconds when only one Life left
item.babel.king_staff.description_1: §oLay down worthless majesty, and treat others with mercy. They will do the same to you, they will.
item.babel.king_fellowship.description_0: §bShield +2, all Life is converted into equal shield (Life will not go below 1)
item.babel.king_fellowship.description_1: §oThe oceanfolk did not come this far overnight; they lingered long at the boundary of sea and land, preparing for the calamity that would be known as the Great Silence.
item.babel.king_buckler.description_0: §bMelee damage taken -20% when only one Life left
item.babel.king_buckler.description_1: §oFace forward, and let a steadfast heart withstand all hardships.
item.babel.sarkaz_king_bed.description_0: §bWhen Life is full, player armor +3, amr toughness +2
item.babel.sarkaz_king_bed.description_1: §oSleeping shall be an eternity for those who enthrone
item.babel.sarkaz_king_banner.descriptio: §bIf Lif is full, player move and swim speed +30%
§oBoycotts shall fail fot those who enthrone
item.babel.sarkaz_king_artifact.descript: §bIf Life full, Player health +50%, which boost to +150% with three Archifiend relics gathered
§oProsperity is virtual to those who enthroned
item.babel.royal_alliance_treaty.descrip: §bDamage from nether mobs reduce 99%, while for bosses it was 50%.
§oWe gain the power of nether, so we stop the hate each other
item.babel.seagrass_salad.description_1: §oRedisents' memory food, but faded with Oceanoffspring
item.babel.acahuallan_bowl.description_0: §bRestores 4 Life Points and grants 2 Objective Shields when used
item.babel.acahuallan_bowl.description_1: §oFruit is one of the locals' staples, often eaten fresh right off the tree.
item.babel.church_alms_voucher.descripti: §bPlayer health +10%, and gain Regeneration II for 25s when used
§oIn the declining coastal towns of Iberia, some churches regularly offer alms meals that believers receive by voucher. How these vouchers are handed out remains a secret.
item.babel.abyssal_wyrdmask.description_: §oA bizarre mask belonging to no known culture. It drains the will to fight... and draws one unwittingly into long contemplation.
item.babel.guardian_stare.description_0: §bPlayer gain 4 levels of exp when used
item.babel.guardian_stare.description_1: §oAnyone who get this summons a desire to explore the ocean
item.babel.sheet_music.description_0: §bPlayer gain 4 levels of exp and attack speed +0.6 when used
item.babel.sheet_music.description_1: §oA broken music score, whose notes blurred. What a story was it talking?
item.babel.proof_of_longevity.descriptio: §oA branch, withering and thriving coexist. Springs from decay, and decays in bloom.
item.babel.hemost.description_1: §oLiquid from this silverfish can heal your hamage
item.babel.solo_music_box.description_1: §oA broken music box, waiting to be fixed
item.babel.toponym_textology.description: §oA book from librarian, which records an Ancient City
item.babel.yearning.description_0: §bPlayer health +1, toughness and knockback resistance +3% with each 2 lels of exp
item.babel.yearning.description_1: §oThese incomplete thoughts cling to their creators, zealously guarding them until they obtain their forms through a sudden revelation and embark on a long journey.
item.babel.allay_sculpture.description_1: §oA hand-size  sculpture, which is said to be created by allay to convert friendlyness
item.babel.king_armor.description_0: §btransfer all Lives to Shield, and 10% chance to gain 1 Shield and cost 1 Life when kill a mob
item.babel.king_armor.description_1: §oSignifying the glorious past, but brings damage to the present
item.babel.king_spear.description_0: §bPlayer attack apeed +1 if only one Life left
item.babel.king_spear.description_1: §oVirtual wishes can bring hope, even if it's a fake
item.babel.king_extension.description_0: §bPlayer gains regeneration II and extra exp when only one Life left
item.babel.king_extension.description_1: §oTo equip yourself with toughness, and your friends with mercifulness
item.babel.king_crystal.description_0: §b20% chance to lose 1 life and gain one level of xp and a emerals
item.babel.king_crystal.description_1: §oFirst day when they meet Oceanoffspring, on ne thinks that they're a disaster
item.babel.royal_fate.description_0: §bShield +3, transfer MaxLife to Shield, the former set to 1
item.babel.survivor_contract.description: §bWhen player kill a mob, he got 35% chance to get 20% addition on health and attack, and armor +2 (20 times limited)
§oAll records of previous survivors, follow which you can make it to the end
item.babel.canned_cherry.description_1: §Candy product by Margosha, made with cherry and wart, loved by a small crowd of people
item.babel.golden_chalice.description_0: §bAttack speed +7% for every 5 Originium Ingots in the backpack.
item.babel.golden_chalice.description_1: §oSaints, knights, and pietists. All of them are madmen.
item.babel.black_tulip.description_0: §bWhile no critical hit lands, critical damage ramps up to +60% over 60 seconds. The bonus is consumed on each critical hit
item.babel.black_tulip.description_1: §oSilence crushed the Iberians, so she must speak; if words are not sharp enough, let the sword speak for her.
item.babel.rock_horn.description_0: §bFor each player within 8 blocks, attack damage +20%, up to 10 players
item.babel.angelina_inspiration.descript: §bNearby enemy units' movement speed -15%, and their weight level is reduced by one
§oAjimu doesn't mind sharing her Arts. She believes you will use them in the right place.
item.babel.old_fan.description_0: §bGain +10% attack damage for each type of profession item in your inventory (hoe, crossbow, bow, shield, axe, sword); each type counts only once, up to +60%
item.babel.old_fan.description_1: §oWhen endless rain sets in, the old Heavenly Master of Yan complains to friends that his knees cannot bear the damp — then waves his palm-leaf fan... clouds part, mist scatters, the rain retreats, and the weather clears. This trick, next time, he really must teach his young disciple serving in the Dali Temple.
item.babel.rainbow_jar.description_0: §bAfter losing health or shield, gain Speed II for 15 seconds and remove one random harmful effect
item.babel.rainbow_jar.description_1: §oThe Sami usually keep it where the rainbow falls, carefully preserved, against the unpredictable disasters and misfortunes.
item.babel.oriron_round_shield.descripti: §oBefore oriron saw wide use in modern industry, the material was often worked into standard-issue military weaponry.
item.babel.friston_p.description_0: §bKilling an elite or boss always adds 1 stack; otherwise a 15% chance. Each stack grants +0.1 attack speed (up to 15 stacks)
item.babel.friston_p.description_1: §oFriston would never miss the chance to pry into another pre-human civilization's secrets. Oh, and Closure knows nothing about the sub-mind backup — whatever you do, don't tell her!
item.babel.string_puppet.description_0: §bEnemies stunned, frozen, or bound take 7 Arts damage per second
item.babel.string_puppet.description_1: §oThe harder you struggle to break free, the tighter the strings coil. Do you really believe you are still the one thinking?
item.babel.emperor_collection.descriptio: §oThe Sami revere their wilds beyond all measure, and now a fragment of those wilds rests quietly in the private vault of the Emperor of Ursus.
item.babel.coin_operated_toy.description: §bAttack speed +3.25% for every 5 Originium Ingots in the backpack.
§oNo idea why anyone likes this design, but the concept is genuinely clever — drop a coin and even stone statues come alive. That part is absolutely true.
item.babel.blaze_chainsaw.description_0: §bWhen enemies are damaged by friendly units, the closer they are to the damage source, the more damage they take (up to +100%)
item.babel.blaze_chainsaw.description_1: §oShe drags herself and her enemies into hell together, testing each other's resolve with blazing heat. She has never failed.
item.babel.standard_riot_gear.descriptio: §bDeals an extra 20% of the damage as Arts damage
§oStandard issue for Ursus military police, equipped with an intermittent blinding Originium Arts function. Unfortunately, few officers remember this feature exists when it actually matters.
item.babel.empty_fowlbeast.description_0: §bNearby pets gain 30% max. health and 30% attack damage, and their owner gains 60% attack damage while a pet is present (does not stack)
item.babel.empty_fowlbeast.description_1: §oThe flesh has long faded, yet the soul dwells on within its shell. An undead spirit among the branches, spreading icy wings through the forest.
item.babel.timeworn_poetry_strips.descri: §bNearby pets gain 30% max. health and 30% attack damage, and take 99% less damage from their owner
§o"Soundly asleep, a thousand mountains slip away; all things breathe with spirits of their own."
item.babel.rusted_razor.description_0: §bNearby enemy units take 15% more physical damage
item.babel.rusted_razor.description_1: §oIf it cuts the skin, you know what happens.
item.babel.fissured_restraints.descripti: §oThis sturdy strap seems to have bound something terrifying...... Help......
item.babel.gold_plated_dice.description_: §oOnly one of the twenty faces bears the mark of survival. As for the other nineteen......
item.babel.emperors_favor.description_0: §bThe player deals 15% more melee attack damage
item.babel.emperors_favor.description_1: §oA very sharp letter opener. A daily item favored by the former Ursus Emperor. Most of the time it is not used for opening letters.
item.babel.frozen_claw.description_0: §bNearby enemy units' attack, defense, and max. health +12%; Boss units additionally gain +16% attack and defense, +20% max. health
item.babel.frozen_claw.description_1: §oEven as explorers like Magallan challenge this unchanging frozen land generation after generation, countless mysteries remain unsolved here... along with things most dreadful.
item.babel.lakebed_aegis.description_0: §bGrants 1 shield on use; while shield is held, max. health +60%
item.babel.lakebed_aegis.description_1: §oThirty years ago, a child's toy wooden shield sank into the lake. Thirty years later, he cut open the frozen lake, took out the shield, and set off on a hero's journey.
block.babel.king_pedestal.description_0: §bSneak-use a king relic to place the pedestal with the relic inside. Right-click to take the relic back, and the pedestal will break itself.
block.babel.golden_chalice.description_0: §oSaints, knights, and pietists. All of them are madmen. Dear God, even the chalice itself is made of pure gold!
block.babel.golden_chalice.description_1: §bPut down and right click with gold ingot to store,
block.babel.golden_chalice.description_2: §bRight click with empty hand to withdraw.
block.babel.golden_chalice.description_3: §bSneak and right click to show balance.
item.babel.coffee_candy.description_1: §oCandy product from Lukewarm Ocean, sold overworld, with cafeine added
item.babel.golden_storm.description_1: §oCandy by Margosha, pop golden apple flavor, know in kids for it's cheapness and tatse
item.babel.odd_flute.description_0: §bGain 28 exp when used, then Strength for 45s
item.babel.odd_flute.description_1: §oFlute with strange shape, and is played day and night
item.babel.featured_canned_meat.descript: §oConvenience is more important than taste for voyagers
item.babel.rescission.description_0: §bPlayer gain 4 levels of exp when used
item.babel.rescission.message_1: This entity is not yours, unable to unbind.
item.babel.rescission.message_2: I now untamed, wish you all good luck.
item.babel.rescission.message_3: However, a mere paper won't sway his loyalty
item.babel.old_steam_armor.description_1: §oEven this old, outdated steam armor seems to carry with it the resplendence of when the Victorian monarchs cast their glory across half the world.
item.babel.brilliant_lament.description_: §bWhen activated, nearby monsters take +40% Arts damage
§oHis blood yet flows. He has never left this place.
item.babel.scouts_scope.description_0: §bThe farther the target is from the damage source, the more damage it takes, capped at +100% (within 32 blocks)
item.babel.scouts_scope.description_1: §oLock on, aim, fire, and destroy the enemy's will to resist, all in the name of a better future that Scout will never see. Maybe you can do it for him.
item.babel.sea_terror_jerky.description_: §bWhen activated, nearby monsters have their armor reduced by 21%
§oOnce their desire to survive overwhelms their terror, the famished Iberians will devour this "food," subsequently turning into Sea Terrors on some ordinary day.
item.babel.cobblestone_altar.description: §bAfter killing an enemy, 7.5% chance to permanently increase attack and armor by 5%, stacking up to 10 times
§oSacrifice the offering, receive the reward. It is so convenient that no one has ever wondered what exactly they were sacrificing to.
item.babel.live_rose.description_0: §bWhen activated, the holder gains +20% healing effectiveness
item.babel.live_rose.description_1: §oIs it you who nourish her, or is it her who protects you?
item.babel.knights_code.description_0: §bAttack speed +5% for every 5 Originium Ingots in the backpack.
item.babel.knights_code.description_1: §oSolemn oaths are a thing of the past; the modern knightly spirit demands a more flexible expression. Enter your number on the communication device, and you too shall be an honorable knight.
item.babel.darknight_whisperer.descripti: §bWhen activated, nearby monsters have their max. HP reduced by 10%
§oA black record. Do. Not. Touch. It.
item.babel.godmothers_token.description_: §bNearby monsters have their attack damage reduced by 17%

§oA laurel of bones, the token of a Sicilian noblewoman. This symbol of order will smooth the turbulence of all desires, for conflict is not allowed. Genuine or counterfeit, it still demands you to kneel.
item.babel.gaulish_silver_coin.descripti: §oCurrency of the fallen nation of Gaul, well preserved and highly collectible.
item.babel.gaulish_bank_check.descriptio: §oAn extravagant checkbook plated in gold and silver. Can no longer be cashed.
item.babel.topographical_map.description: §oA hand-drawn map that exudes a sense of antiquity. The labels and corresponding terrain have been enlarged, and there seems to be something off about its scale.
item.babel.hand_of_flowing_water.descrip: §bAfter using a bow or crossbow, use speed +25%, each finished use grants 1 stack for max 4 stacks, and get emptied if not using for 8s; bows and crossbows no longer consume arrows (including tipped arrows)
§oThe ocean's flow never ceases, because it is always surging.
item.babel.divine_conch.description_1: §oSound it, and gods you've never seen or even heard of will answer your call. Actually, it's just a hollow conch shell.
item.babel.flawless_jadestone.descriptio: §oEven though it thrice brought the city to ruins, it yet shines radiantly in its flawless form. Even today, the Sargon emperor in possession of the gem has yet to find another piece of jewelry matching its brilliance, leaving it with naught but gunsmoke for a companion.
